changeSet.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_daily_recon_summary AS WITH trade_summary AS ( SELECT t.trade_date, cp.region, i.asset_class, COUNT(*) AS total_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'MATCHED') AS matched_trades, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t.quantity * t.price), 0)::numeric, 2) AS gross_notional, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'MATCHED')::numeric * 100 / COUNT(*)) END, 2 ) AS match_rate_pct FROM trades t JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.id = t.counterparty_id JOIN instruments i ON i.id = t.instrument_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.trade_date, cp.region, i.asset_class ), break_summary AS ( SELECT t.trade_date, cp.region, i.asset_class, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rb.status = 'OPEN') AS open_breaks FROM recon_breaks rb JOIN trades t ON t.id = rb.trade_id JOIN counterparties cp ON cp.id = t.counterparty_id JOIN instruments i ON i.id = t.instrument_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.trade_date, cp.region, i.asset_class ) SELECT ts.trade_date, ts.region, ts.asset_class, ts.total_trades, ts.matched_trades, COALESCE(bs.open_breaks, 0) AS open_breaks, ts.gross_notional, ts.match_rate_pct FROM trade_summary ts LEFT JOIN break_summary bs USING (trade_date, region, asset_class) WITH NO DATA;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_daily_recon_summary ON mv_daily_recon_summary (trade_date, region, asset_class);

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_daily_recon_summary;
